描述_EN: around 1580 a new type of blue-and-white porcelain was developed at jingdezhen in china. this commerce was driven primarily by the dutch east india company (founded 1602), which shipped the new wares in unprecedented quantities. originally intended for export around asia it was soon traded across the world, including the americas.
描述_ZN: 大约在1580年，一种新型的青花瓷在中国的景德镇被开发出来。 这种贸易主要由荷兰东印度公司（1602年成立）推动，该公司以前所未有的数量运送新的器皿。 最初是为了出口到亚洲各地，它很快被交易到世界各地，包括美洲。
